title: toolu --json documents
description: The root validates `toolu commands --json` (toolu.commands/v1). $defs holds every other document a toolu command prints under --json.

epicSummary.description: toolu epic summary --json: one epic's run beside the TypeScript baseline, the budget table, and token use per worker read from host session records (#451).

epicMetrics.description: toolu epic metrics --json and GET /api/v1/metrics: epic runs measured from the engine journal (#451). Durations are milliseconds.

epicPercentiles.description: Linear-interpolated percentiles of millisecond durations, rounded down; null without values.

epicBaseline.description: toolu epic baseline: the TypeScript-era figures derived from recorded epic state directories (benchmarks/epic-baseline.json).

commands.description: toolu commands --json: the full command tree.

codeReview.description: toolu code-review run --json: the review report (schema_version 3). Exit 0 approved, 2 blocked, 69 error.

error.description: Any command under --json that ends with a non-zero exit and no document of its own.

planned.description: toolu <namespace> planned --json, for a namespace not ported yet.

doctor.description: toolu doctor --json. The report is on stdout even when a check failed.

status.description: toolu status --json, the same document StatusSnapshot returns.

setupAgents.description: toolu setup agents prints text lines (TARGET, PLAN, then a summary or NOTICE). Refusals exit 2. Stdout is text, not JSON.

empty.description: A successful command under --json that has no data.

ledger.description: A plan ledger (version 1) as toolu ledger run and status write it.

ledgerRun.description: toolu ledger run --json once a ledger was written.

ledgerStatus.description: toolu ledger status --json once a ledger was rewritten.

ledgerSelfTest.description: toolu ledger self-test --json when the self-test passes.

gate.description: One verdict gate: its state, its reason, and gate-specific extras.

verdict.description: toolu ledger verdict json, and verdict status under --json: the four push gates.

epicQueue.description: toolu epic queue --json: each repository's merge queue, in merge order.

epicJudgment.description: toolu epic wait --json when a judgment is queued.

epicWaiting.description: toolu epic wait --json when the limit passes with no judgment.

pluginsStep.description: One plugin's step in a toolu plugins report. A removal has removed instead of outcome.

pluginsHost.description: toolu plugins remove --json, and update --host --json: one host's steps.

pluginsInstall.description: toolu plugins install --json, and update --json without --host: the steps of every host acted on.

pluginsList.description: toolu plugins list --json: every catalog plugin with the host's state; version only when known.

pluginsDoctor.description: toolu plugins doctor --json: plugin lifecycle findings per host, with counts.

sandboxSettings.description: The sandbox settings of toolu.config.json with their defaults filled in.

sandboxStatus.description: toolu sandbox status --json: the backend, its state, why it cannot run when it cannot, the settings and this project.

sandboxSetup.description: toolu sandbox setup --json: the tools still missing (exit 69 while any is) and how to install and log in to each agent CLI.

sandboxVm.description: toolu sandbox start, stop and delete --json: the state after the verb and whether it changed anything.

gitBetterCheck.description: toolu git-better check --json: the failed checks of a commit message and a branch name. Exit 0 when ok, 1 when a check failed.

gitBetterFinding.description: One commit message or branch name that failed its checks, with a corrected example.

gitBetterSetup.description: toolu git-better setup --json: the notes ref this repository's notes.rewriteRef now includes, and whether setup added it.
